# fine-tuning-data-generator

Generates synthetic fine-tuning datasets in ChatML format (JSONL) for use with Unsloth, Axolotl, and similar training frameworks. Gathers requirements, creates datasets with diverse examples, validates quality, and provides framework integration guidance.

- **Entry point:** [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)
- **Version:** 2.0
- **Licence:** Apache-2.0, see [LICENSE](LICENSE)

## Install

Copy this directory into either skills location, then start a new session:

```bash
cp -r fine-tuning-data-generator ~/.claude/skills/       # personal, all projects
cp -r fine-tuning-data-generator .claude/skills/         # this project only
```

For Claude Desktop, zip the directory and upload it under
Settings, Capabilities, Skills. Released builds attach a ready-made zip.

## Bundled files

Loaded on demand, not up front. SKILL.md routes to them.

- `resources/chatml-format.md`
